opening.argument: The video presents OneCoin as a chance to participate through education packages, trading tokens, exchange activity, and a signup invitation. It says, “With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens so-called One Tokens,” and links those tokens to exchange trading and potential profit. It further claims that “the split program can double your tokens portfolio,” with portfolio value potentially increasing in under 10 weeks. Most significantly, it ties bonuses to becoming an active marketing partner, popularizing OneCoin, and “building your own sales team.” This recruitment-based structure supports the claimed opportunity to earn through commissions and tiered participation. The available evidence does not establish package pricing, required payments, actual profits, completed transactions, or the destination’s behavior.
